references.text: Describes the same amount of drink offering (a quarter hin) that was to accompany each lamb in the daily sacrifice
Gives instructions about a drink offering of a quarter hin of wine for each lamb that is sacrificed
Describes the amounts of drink offerings for the new moon sacrifice, including a quarter hin for each lamb
Refers to drink offerings of wine in connection with sacrifices on holy days
Mentions the sanctuary (baqqodesh) as the place for special offerings to the Lord
Describes the drink offering as part of the concluding ritual of the Nazirite vow
